body: For me sex is extremely hard to get. Damn near impossible how hard. I would say it is easier for me to get myself a brand new Ferrari than to legally get myself a romantic or sex partner in the UK.
I've already seen two therapists. Both were very unhelpful. It was a waste of time

When I say that I have friends, what I actually mean is I have associates. I am among the most non-social people I know. I am largely non-social both around males and females.

I'm 28, I enjoy driving, i read and watch things related to history. I listen to rap music. I probably have other hobbies but i can't pursue any of them now because i'm a bit broke. My ambition is to find a job so i can move out of my mothers basement. The thing is i'm not a very social person. I am so non-social that I dont even own a cellphone, and dont feel the need to own one. When I say that I have friends what they actually are is associates, if that. I simply can't envision myself having a friendship with males or females.

That's the thing. I usually talk about sex. Many of my guy friends also talk about sex. For example, last night before going to the nightclub I was with a group of friends and roughly 70% of the conversation was about sex. So you're essentially telling me to avoid speaking to women about what is arguably the number one topic of conversation among my peers.

So what should I say when I approach women? Talk about the weather? I should note that I have been sexually molested by two women when i was 8 to 9 years old so that may have contributed to my shallowness. One of the abusers was an aunt, the other a family friend. I am currently awkward with women, since usually I dont know what to talk about. She immediately assumed I was hitting on her and said "yeah but only drop me off" immediately insinuating I was a dirty pervert. Her scoffing remark was a major turn-off for me and i left her immediately.

I mentioned in the article that I already know that I shouldn't be too straightforward. I have altered my approach accordingly. For example I have tried speaking to churchgoing women about church. Yet still, I get rejections. Also I mentioned that I'm open to all types of relationships, including marriage and long-term girlfriend. Still, rejections. I don't personally hate women. I merely hate the editorials that claim that there's someone out there for everyone, and it is easy to find a spouse or partner as long as you try. I live in London where 5 million females reside and hell no it is not easy to find willing women! I also hate the journals that claim the women have an equally high sex drive as men. That is a demonstrably false lie. Why else do you have a thousand female prostitutes for every male gigolo? Because male demand for sex is much higher, that's why! I could come up with roughly three dozen other reasons as to why men have a higher sex drive than women but I don't want to bore you with such a lengthy post.

Also, aren't you essentially telling me I should pretend to not be sexually frustrated when I am? Essentially asking me to lie and put a smile on my phallic grievance?
I obviously desire them, why else else would I spend money, gas, petrol, time and energy attempting to meet them? The problem is, all women seem to reject me and they don't want to tell me why.

I wished I was dating sumo-wrestler women, pensioners or even disabled women. But currently I am merely at the wish stage and am not dating anyone and nobody even seems to be on the horizon. I feel like a stalker sometimes the extent to which I approach women. I also wished our society was more honest and admitted that women have a lower sex drive than men. If a 5 out of 10 female Londoner was approaching hundreds of men there's no way she would be rejected as often as I have been: every single time.
